stories.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
stories.body: Officials have so far managed to avoid a repeat of last weekend's rioting and looting as hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations.

stories.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
stories.body: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.

stories.title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes
stories.body: The crackdown follows the killing of two Israeli soldiers by two Palestinian gunmen on Friday - and comes just days ahead of Israel's election.

stories.title: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
stories.body: Some 200 emergency personnel were deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.

stories.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
stories.body: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

stories.title: British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas
stories.body: Nathan Gregory says the loss of childhood sweetheart Leanne "is unimaginable for our family".

stories.title: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis
stories.body: The ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr, with whom she shares five children, announced in May that she had been diagnosed with breast cancer.

stories.title: Three released without charge after fatal arson attack in Ireland
stories.body: Three people - two women and one man - have been released, and one person remains in custody, gardaí say.

stories.title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
stories.body: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

stories.title: Australian MP's condition improves after alleged car attack
stories.body: The independent MP is now in a serious but stable condition, according to the Melbourne hospital.

stories.title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election
stories.body: The Student List has emerged from almost two years of anti-corruption protests to form the biggest challenge to Vučić's rule.

stories.title: White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom
stories.body: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.

stories.title: Two rescued after Nairobi building collapse with five still missing
stories.body: Police have launched a manhunt for the building's owner and contractor after the multi-storey building collapsed while still under construction.

stories.title: Trump administration sues to block certification of upcoming Alaska election
stories.body: The justice department has filed a lawsuit arguing that the inclusion of two candidates named Dan Sullivan could confuse voters.

stories.title: Minneapolis withdrawal was 'surrender', Trump's ex-border patrol chief tells BBC
stories.body: Greg Bovino was the public face of the controversial immigration enforcement operation in the city earlier this year.

stories.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
stories.body: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

stories.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
stories.body: Thirty-four people are also injured in the attack in southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

stories.title: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
stories.body: Javier Milei had denied acting fraudulently when a cryptocurrency nosedived after he deleted a social media post about it.

stories.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
stories.body: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.

stories.title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
stories.body: Ukrainians held alongside the American say they witnessed beatings and sexual humiliation by Russian guards during his detention.

The report of Melania Trump's involvement in brokering a truce for a Ukrainian city on the brink of disaster is notable for its high contestedness score. **4. Longer-term trajectories highlight the need for resilience and adaptability.**

The focus on survival and stability suggests a reactive posture, with limited bandwidth for proactive, long-term solutions. However, the emergence of grassroots movements, such as the student-led push in Serbia, hints at a potential shift toward more participatory governance models in the future. The contested narratives around key decisions, such as tariff adjustments and diplomatic interventions, also highlight the importance of transparency and consensus-building in maintaining legitimacy.

**What to watch next:**  
1. The durability of Starlink's restored services in Ukraine and its impact on the broader conflict dynamics.  
2. The trajectory of U.S.-Canada trade relations post-tariff adjustments, particularly in the context of upcoming midterm elections.  
3. Developments in Serbia's election, as the student movement's momentum could signal a broader shift in the region's political landscape.
